Hi Sally — welcome, and thanks for sending the sample. Looping in Karthik (procurement integration) and Jordan (onboarding ops) so we can confirm the technical path. Short answers up front: the portal is our recommended default for production (better metadata, tracking, idempotency). We support email fallback for legacy suppliers with a subject-token convention.

High-level differences:
- Portal: preferred for production, supports multi-PO lines, automated PO matching, faster ACKs, and richer metadata (payment entity, remit-to).
- Email fallback: acceptable for a transition window; requires a strict CSV layout and a subject token (see example below). Email ingestion has longer SLA for manual exception handling.

Subject token format for email fallback: REDWOOD-ALDER-<vendor-id>-<env> (example: REDWOOD-ALDER-7421-PROD)

Quick review of your attached CSV: the core fields we need to map are invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), line_description, quantity, unit_price, tax_amount, po_numbers (pipe-delimited if multiple), remit_entity. Karthik — adding a suggested header mapping below.

Next step: Karthik, can you confirm the mapping and whether we need any field name changes so AlderTech can export directly to our email ingestion schema? If everything looks good, Jordan will provision a test portal account and a temporary email token for a staged test.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Thanks, Marissa. Sally — I reviewed AlderTech_invoice_sample.csv. I can map it with minimal changes but want to call out three important items so your AP team avoids delays:

1) Multi-PO handling: please put multiple POs in the po_numbers column separated by the pipe character (|). Example: PO-10023|PO-10024. Our ingestion will split and attempt to match each PO; if more than one PO is matched to a single line we mark the line as multi-PO and surface it for PO reconciliation.

2) PO stamping: after ingestion we store matched PO ids and add an acknowledgement file that includes "redwood_po_matches" (list) and an "ack_code" you can use to reconcile. That ack file is available in the portal and sent to the email sender when using the fallback token.

3) Taxes & currency: include tax_amount as a separate numeric column and currency as a 3-letter code (USD). If you have VAT registration numbers on the invoice, add vat_number as a free-text column.

Suggested CSV header we accept (exact order not required, names should match):
invoice_number,invoice_date,line_description,quantity,unit_price,tax_amount,currency,po_numbers,remit_entity,vat_number,external_reference

I recommend the portal for the go-live test — it will produce the cleanest ACKs and let us validate PO matching without manual steps. Jordan, can you schedule a portal sandbox account for AlderTech and a one-time email token for fallback testing?

-Karthik
Director, Vendor Integrations
Redwood Inference

Great questions — answers below:  

1) Multiple attachments: yes, the portal allows multiple attachments per invoice (PDF manifests, delivery receipts). For email fallback, include attachments inline; we accept up to 5 attachments per submission and will store them in the portal sandbox for review. Name attachments clearly (invoice123_manifest.pdf).

2) Payment aggregation: Redwood does not change how your payables team issues payments. Our system will expose matched PO lines and a per-invoice total. If multiple POs are matched to one invoice line, our ACK will include the allocation mapping (how the total maps to each PO) — your finance team can then drive payment split or a single consolidated payment depending on your terms.

Timeline: Jordan will provision a sandbox account within 48 business hours after we receive signed vendor paperwork (we have your W9). Production onboarding (SFTP/portal + monitoring) typically takes 7–10 business days after sandbox validation.

Next steps (action items):
- AlderTech: confirm you can export with the suggested header names and run one CSV to our sandbox (Jordan will share credentials). (Owner: Sally)
- Redwood: Jordan to create sandbox and provide portal walkthrough + temporary email token. (Owner: Jordan)
- Redwood: Karthik to validate the first sandbox submission and confirm PO matching rules. (Owner: Karthik)

Jordan — please create the sandbox and post credentials to the shared Drive folder and HUBSPOT-45219. Sally — once you run the sandbox test, paste the ACK code here so we can close the loop.

Thanks everyone — happy to jump on a 20m call if that helps accelerate.
